cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:b3fd34c3-08a9-4b.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE: The position of Senior Analyst, Financial Reporting is responsible for the preparation of financial and SEC reporting of CIM’s public funds, under the supervision of the Manager or Director of Financial Reporting. The role requires strong independent judgment and discretion and operating with limited supervision.
responsibilities: Prepare required SEC filings, which include Forms 10-K, 10-Q, publicly filed supplementals, 8-K, and supporting schedules.
Work with asset financial services and portfolio oversight to prepare and analyze monthly portfolio metrics (real estate).
Prepare monthly/quarterly internal reporting for the senior leadership team.

Coordinate with investor relations, communications, general ledger accounting and portfolio management to ensure accuracy of quarterly earnings release materials, marketing materials and investor presentations.
Ensure compliance with GAAP and internal controls.
Review asset level reporting prepared by asset level accountants.
Assist in technical accounting research related to the property application and disclosure of accounting pronouncements and SEC guidance.
Assist with real estate investment & debt schedules for valuations; prepare supporting cost & debt roll forwards.
Support the independent auditor through quarterly reviews and annual audits.
Drive data analytics and automation efforts to enhance reporting and streamline processes.
qualifications: College degree in accounting (BA or BS); MAcc or advanced degree a plus.
3+ years of progressive experience in financial reporting or accounting or audit, or related roles. Ideally at least two years’ public accounting experience and financial reporting.
Big 4 or other public accounting experience (preferred)
CPA (preferred)
Demonstrated knowledge and application of GAAP accounting
Ability to independently organize and manage multiple tasks in a detailed and deadline-oriented environment with minimal supervision
Analytical and critical thinking skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Time management
Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word

jobgether-jobgether:lever:15cb2c02-ba1a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Engineer, Data Platform and Governance (Snowflake and AWS) based in India. This is a senior technical leadership opportunity focused on building scalable, secure, and production-grade data governance infrastructure. You will architect governance solutions across Snowflake and AWS while turning policies and compliance requirements into automated engineering systems. The role combines cloud data platforms, infrastructure as code, identity management, security, compliance, and platform reliability. You will enable secure self-service data access while improving cost efficiency, auditability, and operational resilience. Working across data, cloud, security, and engineering stakeholders, you will help establish governance standards that can operate effectively at enterprise scale. You will also contribute to modern data architectures involving Iceberg, Airflow, Lambda, EventBridge, and emerging AI/ML capabilities. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex platform challenges and creating durable, automated governance foundations. Architect and implement Snowflake security and governance frameworks covering RBAC, functional and access role patterns, network and authentication policies, dynamic data masking, and secure access controls. Design and optimize Snowflake platform economics through warehouse sizing, compute virtualization, resource monitors, query tagging, alerts, and reserved-capacity planning. Implement data protection and compliance controls, including row-level access policies, column-level masking, PII tagging, and Access History auditing. Manage identity and authentication infrastructure, including scalable role hierarchies, federated authentication, and Okta/SCIM integrations. Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code to provision, standardize, and enforce governance controls across environments. Develop automated access-request, approval, certification, monitoring, and compliance workflows through CI/CD pipelines. Create governance monitoring capabilities that identify access anomalies, policy violations, and compliance issues in near real time. Lead the technical implementation of SOX or similar compliance controls, including audit-ready reporting, evidence collection, and continuous compliance validation. Architect secure data-sharing patterns across Snowflake, Iceberg, and AWS services such as S3, Athena, and Spark. Support governed data orchestration using Airflow/MWAA, Lambda, and EventBridge while ensuring consistent security and governance across data engines. Establish governance foundations for Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including Cortex, Agents, and Snowpark ML. Act as a technical escalation point for data governance and platform reliability issues while enabling secure self-service for engineering and data teams. Drive reusable governance patterns that reduce manual effort, improve audit readiness, accelerate data delivery, and optimize platform costs. Requirements: Strong hands-on expertise with Snowflake governance, including RBAC, row-level security, dynamic data masking, network and authentication policies, resource monitors, and Access History. Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, with the ability to replace manual configuration processes with reliable automation. Solid AWS experience, particularly with S3 storage integrations, IAM trust policies, and multi-engine cloud data architectures. Experience designing scalable identity and access-management models, including federated authentication, RBAC hierarchies, and Okta/SCIM integrations. Practical experience supporting SOX, SOC 2, or comparable enterprise compliance programs, including audit evidence generation and control documentation. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Belgium. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage.
